name: @opafex/knowledge-grid
description: Structured context for AI agents — a layered knowledge grid with vector indexing, domain inference, intent-driven retrieval, and token-budgeted prompt composition. Better context, better agent performance. Zero dependencies.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run check:dist
scripts.check:dist: node -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(m=>{const n=Object.keys(m).length;if(n<10)throw new Error('only '+n+' exports');console.log('dist loads in plain Node: '+n+' exports')})"
